author: Minecraft
description:
It’s time to take a closer look at Minecraft Dungeons II! What’s the deal with those flying souls? And what about that terrifying warden? Get the scoop from Laura, Carlos and Kevin as they delve deeper into the story, characters, and gameplay we caught a glimpse of in the trailer. They were oddly cagey about that deep dark portal, though. Hmmm.

Learn more about Minecraft Dungeons II: https://www.minecraft.net/about-dungeons-ii
title: A NEW THREAT APPROACHING.... | MINECRAFT DUNGEONS II
